single_source_of_truth.description: This document is the sole scientific specification governing R4. Any execution component must implement this protocol without silently changing its scientific rules.

scientific_scope.objective: Evaluate whether the NeuroCortex Self-Reinforcing Development Framework (SRDF) can perform controlled runtime structural adaptation through a closed-loop process in which candidate changes are generated, evaluated, authorized or rejected, committed when authorized, and recorded.
out_of_scope: claims beyond the evaluated datasets, protocol, and metrics

scientific_question: Under a fixed and reproducible evaluation protocol, does the NeuroCortex SRDF mechanism produce authorized structural adaptations that provide measurable predictive effects relative to the specified baseline while maintaining the required authorization and execution constraints?

hypotheses.H1_structural: When the protocol trigger is satisfied, SRDF can generate candidate structural modifications that pass the defined evaluation and authorization procedure.
hypotheses.H2_predictive: Authorized structural adaptation can produce a measurable change in the specified predictive evaluation metric relative to the baseline.
hypotheses.H3_generalization: The observed behavior can be evaluated across the predefined dataset cohort and repeated folds/seeds without changing the protocol after observing results.

srdf_workflow.Observe: Collect the information permitted by the protocol from the current training partition and experimental state.
srdf_workflow.Analyze: Analyze the observed training information and determine whether the protocol trigger condition is satisfied.
srdf_workflow.Generate: Generate candidate structural adaptations only when the trigger condition is satisfied. Candidate generation is performed by the defined Generator mechanism.
srdf_workflow.Evaluate: Evaluate generated candidates using only the evaluation procedure defined by this protocol.
srdf_workflow.Authorize: The Arbiter independently determines whether a candidate satisfies the predefined authorization criteria.
srdf_workflow.Commit_or_Reject: An authorized candidate may be committed according to the protocol; a rejected candidate must not be committed.
srdf_workflow.Record: Record the complete protocol-defined state, decisions, outcomes, and required measurements.

candidate_authorization_separation.arbiter_role: Evaluate authorization eligibility against predefined criteria.

trigger.name: imbalance_ratio
trigger.not_triggered_behavior: When IR < 3.0, the Generator must not execute and no SRDF structural adaptation may be generated.
trigger.triggered_behavior: When IR >= 3.0, the complete SRDF workflow is eligible to execute.

baseline.definition: The predefined non-adaptive reference condition executed under the same dataset and fold evaluation framework.

comparison.primary_comparison: SRDF condition versus the predefined baseline under matched dataset/fold evaluation.

structural_adaptation.required_definition: A structural adaptation is a protocol-permitted change to the defined system structure produced through the Generate → Evaluate → Authorize → Commit_or_Reject pathway.

cohort.selection_rule: The dataset cohort must be defined a priori and locked before scientific execution.

statistics.statistical_method: The inferential procedure must be specified and frozen before the corresponding comparison is interpreted.

claim_boundaries.supported: Claims directly supported by the recorded protocol-defined evidence.
claim_boundaries.partially_supported: Claims for which only a subset of the required evidence is available.
claim_boundaries.unsupported: Claims for which the required evidence is absent.
claim_boundaries.inconsistent: Claims contradicted by the recorded evidence.
claim_boundaries.cannot_determine: Claims for which the available evidence is insufficient to determine the requested conclusion.
claim_boundaries.general_rule: No claim may exceed the population, datasets, metrics, comparisons, and procedures actually evaluated by this protocol.

amendment_policy.after_freeze: No scientific rule may be changed after protocol freeze for the purpose of improving, rescuing, or explaining observed results.

final_claim_rule: R4 conclusions must be derived only after execution, aggregation, statistical analysis, integrity verification, and evidence audit. No result may be invented, inferred from execution completion, or promoted beyond the evidence actually produced by this protocol.
